WITH pref_promo AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
),
pref_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
pref_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM pref_dates AS d
JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN pref_promo AS p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN pref_cd AS c ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = c.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
